name: colab-pilot
description: Zero-waste Google Colab orchestration with GPU cascade provisioning, Drive staging, detached jobs, and Compute Unit leak hooks.

interface.shortDescription: Zero-waste Google Colab GPU orchestration and telemetry.
interface.longDescription: Orchestrate Google Colab GPUs and CPU shards with zero wasted Compute Units. Stage large datasets to Google Drive at zero cost, provision BF16 GPU cascades, launch detached jobs resilient to WebSocket drops, and guard against orphaned sessions.
defaultPrompt: Open the Colab Pilot live dashboard and audit Compute Unit burn.
Pre-stage training archives to Drive at zero cost and launch a detached BF16 GPU job.
Fan out a sharded CPU extraction job across 5 parallel Colab VMs.
